decisions.text: type line: a regular series whose pattern of change is the point (06 DP6-1, G1.51)
zero included (a narrow range far from zero wants an inset)
each line its own colour, handed out top to bottom by the line ends: East slot 1, West slot 2
each line labelled at its end, in the text grey, none moved
no point markers: no value is isolated and no straight run hides one
the unit phrase on the top label: “$80K (revenue)”; the top gridline starts after it
digits hidden: thousands, stated once on the top label (R2-05, D-3): “$80K (revenue)”
time axis: row 2 (“2022”) left out, the title gives it (G2.37)
the title wraps onto two lines

source.shows: the book's demonstration: 24 values as a table, for looking them up (turned, months down the page, so that it fits the text width: the book runs them across); variant line, the same data as the graph, in which East's rise and its ups and downs, West's flat line and September's dip show at once (R10-1)
